departments.title: Sales
departments.description: Dynamics 365 Sales delivery: lead to opportunity, sales process stages, products and price lists, quotes and orders, forecasting, sequences, Copilot in Sales and the Outlook and Teams experience.

skills.name: copilot-in-sales

skills.name: sequences-and-sales-accelerator

skills.name: email-and-sms-channels

skills.title: Monitoring
skills.description: Sets up operational monitoring for Dynamics 365 CE and Power Platform, covering service health, Message center, capacity, plug-in and flow failures, integration errors, telemetry, business heartbeats and alert routing. Use when preparing operations before go-live, deciding what to alert on and who receives it, or when users find failures first.

skills.name: release-readiness
skills.title: Release readiness
skills.description: Prepares a Dynamics 365 CE estate for Microsoft updates, covering roadmap tracking on the AI at Work roadmap, release waves and early access, impact assessment, regression testing, feature enablement and user communication. Use when a major update approaches, early access opens, or a roadmap item or deprecation affects the solution.

departments.title: Support Operations
departments.description: Going live and staying live: cutover planning, hypercare, the support model, incident management and continuous improvement.

skills.name: continuous-improvement
skills.title: Continuous improvement
skills.description: Runs the post-go-live improvement cycle for Dynamics 365 CE with one prioritised backlog, a release cadence aligned to Microsoft release waves, adoption feedback loops and value reporting to the sponsor. Use when setting up the backlog after hypercare, agreeing a release rhythm, or deciding what to improve next.

skills.name: cutover-plan
skills.title: Cutover plan
skills.description: Plans the move from legacy systems to live Dynamics 365 CE as a timed, owned runbook with rehearsals, data freeze rules, decision checkpoints and rollback triggers. Use when building or rehearsing a cutover runbook, agreeing a data freeze, sequencing final migration and integration switch-on, or deciding the point of no return.

skills.name: hypercare
skills.title: Hypercare
skills.description: Runs the hypercare period after a Dynamics 365 CE go-live, setting scope, planned duration, staffing, daily triage, fix cadence and exit criteria for handing over to business-as-usual support. Use when planning hypercare, running triage in the first weeks after go-live, or deciding whether to extend or exit hypercare.

skills.name: incident-management
skills.title: Incident management
skills.description: Defines how Dynamics 365 CE incidents are classified, escalated, communicated and closed, including severity definitions, major incident handling, escalation to Microsoft and post-incident review. Use when writing severity definitions, handling a live outage or serious defect, or setting up post-incident and problem reviews.

skills.name: support-model
skills.title: Support model
skills.description: Designs the business-as-usual support model for Dynamics 365 CE, covering support tiers, partner versus internal responsibilities, Microsoft support cases, the service owner role and support access to production. Use when deciding who supports the system after go-live, scoping a partner support contract, or defining routes to Microsoft.

departments.title: Design Authority
departments.description: Reviewer-class: design review, customisation challenge, standards conformance and change impact assessment. Blocking findings are not overruled by the department under review.

skills.name: change-impact-assessment
skills.title: Change impact assessment
skills.description: Assesses proposed changes to a signed-off Dynamics 365 CE design for impact on data model, automation, security, integrations, migration, testing, training, cost and timeline, recording findings as blocking or advisory. Use when a change request arrives after design sign-off, during UAT or cutover, or after go-live.

skills.name: customisation-challenge
skills.title: Customisation challenge
skills.description: Challenges proposed customisations of Dynamics 365 CE by walking them down the gap resolution hierarchy (adopt standard, configure, low-code, pro-code, ISV) and testing supportability over time. Use when a team proposes custom code, a new custom table, a PCF control, an ISV product or any departure from standard behaviour.

skills.name: design-review
skills.title: Design review
skills.description: Reviews Dynamics 365 CE solution designs against the approved blueprint, architecture principles and project standards, and records each finding as blocking or advisory. Use when a workstream submits a design for approval at a gate or before build, or when a design appears to depart from the blueprint or clash with another workstream.

skills.name: standards-conformance
skills.title: Standards conformance
skills.description: Checks built Dynamics 365 CE components against project standards for naming, publisher prefix, solution layering, security and ALM, and reports each nonconformity as blocking or advisory. Use when reviewing solutions before deployment, auditing an environment for drift, onboarding a new partner, or gathering release evidence.

departments.title: Security and Compliance
departments.lead_role: Security Architect and Data Protection Officer
departments.description: Reviewer-class: security model review, business units and teams, field-level security, marketing consent compliance and data retention. Blocking findings are not overruled by the department under review.

skills.name: business-units-and-teams
skills.title: Business units and teams
skills.description: Designs and reviews the Dataverse business unit tree and the use of owner, access and Entra ID group teams, so that data is segregated only where it must be, and classifies findings as blocking or advisory. Use when deciding business units, choosing team types, planning a restructure or modelling several legal entities.

skills.name: data-retention
skills.title: Data retention
skills.description: Designs and reviews how long CRM data is kept and how it is deleted, anonymised or retained, covering bulk deletion, Dataverse long-term retention, audit logs, call recordings and downstream copies, and classifies findings as blocking or advisory. Use when setting retention rules, planning deletion jobs or handling erasure requests.

skills.name: field-level-security
skills.title: Field-level security
skills.description: Decides which Dataverse columns need column-level protection, designs field security profiles and checks that the protection holds in exports, reports and integrations, classifying findings as blocking or advisory. Use when values such as salary, bank details or vulnerability flags must be hidden from some users who can see the record.

skills.name: marketing-consent-compliance
skills.title: Marketing consent compliance
skills.description: Reviews marketing consent against UK GDPR and PECR, covering lawful basis, consent records, soft opt-in, preference centres, tracking and subject access across Customer Insights - Journeys and seller outreach, and classifies findings as blocking or advisory. Use when marketing is about to go live or consent is being migrated.

skills.name: security-model-review
skills.title: Security model review
skills.description: Reviews a Dataverse security model as an independent reviewer, covering security roles, privilege depth, teams, hierarchy security, record sharing and Entra ID access, and classifies every finding as blocking or advisory. Use when a role matrix needs sign-off, before UAT or go-live, or when users see records they should not.

departments.title: Project Tailoring
departments.description: Turns an organisation profile of team, goals and estate into a tailored pack: edition choice, project roles filled from declared skills, skills gaps, and ready-to-complete Word and Excel templates.

skills.name: document-pack
skills.title: Document pack
skills.description: Fills the twelve project templates from the organisation profile, the edition decision and the confirmed role mapping, and writes Word and Excel drafts to the output folder in the user workspace, never into the repository. Use when a team wants its tailored charter, RACI, plans, logs and checklists produced as a first draft pack.

skills.name: edition-selection
skills.title: Edition selection
skills.description: Recommends the SMB or Enterprise edition of D365Forge for a project from its modules, user numbers, integrations, legal entities and team size, giving the reason for each signal and explaining borderline cases. Use when tailoring starts, when someone asks whether their project is SMB or Enterprise, or when scope changes.

skills.name: pack-refresh
skills.title: Pack refresh
skills.description: Re-runs the tailored pack after the organisation profile changes, re-checking edition, roles and gaps only where the change reaches, keeping earlier versions and reporting what moved. Use when scope, team, dates or estate change, when people join or leave the project, or before a stage gate that needs an up-to-date pack.

skills.name: profile-intake
skills.title: Profile intake
skills.description: Builds or validates the organisation profile that drives a tailored D365Forge pack, checking a YAML file against the schema or interviewing the user, and asks only for what is missing while defaulting to aliases for people. Use when tailoring starts, when a profile fails validation or when someone wants to describe their organisation.

skills.name: role-mapping
skills.title: Role mapping
skills.description: Proposes who holds each delivery role by matching declared skills and availability against the role catalogue, gives a one-line reason per role, flags uncovered, over-allocated and unsafe role combinations, and never ranks people. Use when a profile lists the team and the project lead needs a first role assignment to confirm.

skills.name: skills-gap-analysis
skills.title: Skills gap analysis
skills.description: Lists the delivery roles the team cannot cover from declared skills and availability and recommends training, a contractor or a partner for each, with the reason and the stage by which it is needed. Use when role mapping shows gaps, when planning outside help or when deciding who will own the platform after go-live.
